scheme_name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Sainik School Imphal
other_conditions: Mizo students permanently residing in Mizoram studying at Sainik School, Imphal
Applicant must not be covered under any other scholarship scheme
Scholarship is granted for one year per class and may be renewed as per rules
If the cadet is found medically unfit for entry into the NDA, the scholarship will be discontinued
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering tuition fees, boarding and lodging charges, uniforms and other necessary expenses for eligible cadets.
